question: Indian sportsperson Praveen Chithravel who missed out on a medal at Commonwealth Games 2022 but made a strong comeback to win silver at the Asian Championships with a national indoor record is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Triple jump indoor.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Praveen Chithravel:-**

 
 
• He is associated with the sport of Triple Jump Indoor.
 
• He missed out on a medal at the Commonwealth Games 2022 but made a strong comeback to win silver at the Asian Championships with a national indoor record.
 
• Praveen Chithravel's silver medal at the Asian Championships with a national indoor record is a significant achievement in the sport of Triple Jump Indoor.
 
 
 
• **Triple Jump Indoor:-**
 
 
• It is a track and field event in which athletes jump as far as possible with a hop, step, and jump technique.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shot Put Indoor:-**

 
 
• It is a track and field event in which athletes throw a heavy spherical object as far as possible.
 
 
 
• **Long Jump Indoor:-**
 
 
• It is a track and field event in which athletes jump as far as possible from a running start.
 
 
 
• **800m Indoor:-**
 
 
• It is a middle-distance running event in which athletes run two laps of a 400m track indoors.
